items.title: Aagaya Bajaaz Ali Akbaram
items.body:
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram,
Ghash me hai bimaar Ali Akbaram...


<<DIVIDER>>

Ashk bahale yeh maa,
Sadqa nikale yeh maa,
Tumko sajale yeh maa,
Dulha banale yeh maa,
Aao jo ek baar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Hichkiyan le le ke maa,
Sunti hai jab bhi azaan,
Tan se nikalti hai jaan,
Lagti hai dil par sina,
Chalti hai talwaar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Agayi shame bala,
Hoti hai maa berida,
Bhool gaye maa ko kya,
Sunte nahi kyun sada,
Maa ke madadgar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Gham se churao ose,
Shakl dikhao ose,
Le ke toh aao ose,
Bhool na jao ose,
Sughra hai bimaar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Woh jo hai maa ki misaal,
Zainabe barqista haal,
Jisne rakha hai qayal,
Pala hai atthara saal,
Zainabe lachaar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Ae mere kadiyal jawan,
Maa ke bandhi resman,
Chalne ko hai karwan,
Tum ho na jane kahan,
Dekho toh ek baar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Tum nahi hona malool,
Maa ko sitam sab qabool,
Sar pe agar che hai dhool,
Bachgaya deene Rasool,
Lut gaya ghar baar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Agaya darbare shaam,
Jamma hai sab qaso aam,
Hansta hai yeh be lagaam,
Bibiyon ka leke naam,
Majmae aghiyaar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....


<<DIVIDER>>


Hai ye sadaye navaid,
Dar pe jo aaye navaid,
Sadqa jo paye navaid,
Leke woh jaye navaid,
Ae mere sarkaar Ali Akbaram...
Agaya bazaar Ali Akbaram.....
